_readme: Every value the agent types into a grant form, used VERBATIM. Anything missing becomes NEEDS HUMAN, never a guess. Setup fills this from the client's documents and answers. Delete keys that do not apply; add your own freely, the agent reads them all.

owner.title: Owner
owner._owner_note: The person who signs and is contacted. Never store the owner's SSN, date of birth or bank details here: forms that ask for them are NEEDS HUMAN.

ownership_demographics._demographics_note: Many grants are restricted to woman-, minority- or veteran-owned businesses. Fill these ONLY with what the client states. Never infer them from a name, a photo or a website. Empty means the agent will not apply to a program that requires it.

business._sam_note: UEI and active SAM.gov registration are required for any federal grant. SAM registration can take weeks, so the agent flags a strong federal fit that is blocked by this early rather than at the deadline. Values: 'active until YYYY-MM-DD', 'in progress', 'none'.
business._numbers_note: Revenue and headcount are copied exactly as the client states them, with the year they belong to. Never rounded up, never projected.
business._location_note: County and rural status decide eligibility for many state, local and USDA programs. Fill from the client, not from a map lookup the client has not confirmed.
business._certifications_note: Only certifications the client actually holds, each with issuer and number, e.g. 'WOSB, SBA, certified 2025-03-01'. A program that requires a certification not listed here is a SKIP.

nonprofit._irs_status_note: '501(c)(3) public charity', '501(c)(3) private foundation', 'other 501(c)', 'fiscally sponsored', or 'none'. A program that requires 501(c)(3) status is a SKIP unless this says so, or says 'fiscally sponsored' and the program accepts fiscal sponsors.

documents._documents_note: Paths relative to this folder (e.g. data/docs/w9.pdf). Every file here is something the client gave you. A form that requires a document listed as empty is NEEDS HUMAN.

presets._amount_note: Empty means: request the smallest of (a) the program's maximum, (b) the total of the matching budget preset in answers.md. Never an amount with no budget behind it.
